targetText: First, the revolution of February 27 was also a social revolution. Every political upheaval, if it is not a mere change of cliques, is a social revolution. The thing is: what class makes that social revolution.
explanation: Lenin clarifies the Marxist distinction between superficial governmental coups and genuine revolutions: any shift that transfers state power from one class to another constitutes a social revolution.

targetText: By the use of clumsy unscientific terminology which confuses “social” with “socialist” revolution, Finansovaya Gazeta tries to conceal from the people the obvious fact that the workers and peasants cannot content themselves with seizure of power by the bourgeoisie.
explanation: Lenin unmasks the semantic tricks of bourgeois commentators who conflate social revolution with full socialism to convince the working masses that stopping at bourgeois rule is the only sensible choice.

targetText:
Not even socialism (and control over the banks and factories does not yet mean socialism) requires anything of the kind.

This is an infamous defamation on socialism. No socialist has ever proposed that the “tens of millions”, i.e., the small and middle peasants, should be deprived of their property (=“made to abdicate their property rights”).
explanation: A vital clarification of socialist property relations: scientific socialism protects the small personal property and livelihoods of working peasants and petty producers, focusing expropriation exclusively on concentrated monopoly capital.

targetText: Socialists are out to make only the landowners and capitalists “abdicate”. To deal a decisive blow at those who are defying the people the way the colliery owners are doing when they disrupt and ruin production, it is sufficient to make a few hundred, at the most one or two thousand, millionaires, bank and industrial and commercial bosses, “abdicate” their property rights.
explanation: Lenin demonstrates the immense class concentration of modern capitalism: breaking the power of a few hundred top financiers and monopoly directors is all that is required to bring basic industry under democratic social control.
